global_art_style: Whimsical Storybook Realism. A soft, hand-painted aesthetic utilizing a warm, nostalgic color palette dominated by earth tones (ochre, burnt sienna, moss green) contrasted with gentle pastels. The rendering employs layered watercolor techniques combined with detailed ink linework to achieve both charm and cinematic depth, suggesting age and comforting familiarity.
